articles.description: A busy political day unfolds with Rahul Gandhi’s “Chhatron Ki Goonj” student outreach programme in Pune and Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s first interaction with the BJP’s newly appointed national office-bearers in Delhi.Rahul Gandhi reached Pune on August 22 for the women-focused edition of “Chhatron Ki Goonj”, part of Congress’s wider student outreach campaign. articles.title: Hyderabad Building Collapse: 7-Storey Structure Crashes in Anjaiah Nagar, 1 Dead | News18
articles.description: A seven-storey building collapsed in Anjaiah Nagar, Madhapur, Hyderabad, triggering a major rescue operation and raising fresh questions over construction safety and building regulations.The latest reports confirm that one person died and two others were injured after the structure collapsed on Saturday. A large portion of the debris reportedly fell onto a neighbouring apartment, while people at a nearby hostel rushed out after the sudden collapse. Rescue teams searched through the rubble to check whether anyone else could be trapped.Questions are now being raised over the construction itself. Reports and local accounts allege that the structure was being built on an unusually small plot close to a nala, with possible violations of building regulations under scrutiny. articles.title: In the 1950s, U.S. nuclear tests were conducted at Bikini and Enewetak; decades later, Guam corals preserved carbon-14 spikes linked to tests in 1954, 1956, and 1958
articles.description: Guam’s coral reefs act as natural historians, chronicling chemical footprints of Cold War-era nuclear tests. Distinct radiocarbon spikes from the years 1954, 1956, and 1958 reveal the pathways of nuclear fallout as it spread through the tropical Pacific. This invaluable information extracted from coral cores charts a sixty-year timeline of the ocean’s chemical changes, enabling scientists to accurately date marine species currently inhabiting these waters.
